0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East) visit the Atlanta Hawks (6-4, 1st in the Southeast) for the Nets' ninth game of the season, and Brooklyn is coming off a win after going 1-3 on the road so far. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) and lists Noah Clowney as day-to-day (illness), while Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Nets lost all four meetings to the Hawks in 2025-26, including a 141-107 defeat in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
